mapper.update: UPDATE twin_scan_delay_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE twin_scan_delay_request SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE twin_scan_delay_request SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(created_at) < CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM twin_scan_delay_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM twin_scan_delay_request WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED') ORDER BY COALESCE(reviewed_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM twin_scan_delay_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}

SELECT subject_user_id AS subjectUserId, option_id AS optionId, COUNT(1) AS approvedCount FROM twin_scan_delay_request WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId} GROUP BY subject_user_id, option_id
SELECT * FROM twin_scan_delay_request WHERE subject_user_id = #{subjectUserId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
